title: FDTD in 3-D + time: configurable sources and materials, mesh convergence (3D+t)
description: A 3-D FDTD study configured by a plain dict (domain, cells per wavelength, sources, materials). The default runs a Hertzian dipole in vacuum on a refinement ladder: the radiated power (near-to-far-field transform) against the closed form, with the observed order, the Richardson-extrapolated value and the GCI; the Maxwell residuals of the field in x, y, z and t (pp.maxwell); then the configured case (the dipole beside a dielectric sphere) on the same ladder: no closed form exists, so it reports its extrapolated value, observed order and GCI against a declared accuracy target. The 3-D field in time is the animation and an interactive three.js viewer.
